## Problem

What pain point does this solve? Why does the current framework not cover it?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you want. Be specific:

- New skill? Which phase does it serve? What are its inputs/outputs?
- New example? Which product type? Which stack?
- Framework change? Which file/section?

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches have you considered?

## Use case

Describe the workflow. Who benefits? How often?

## Example

Show the user-facing API (prompt / command / config).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, related issues.
